children: Revvity launched the GSP T1D 3plex kit, a fully automated, CE‑IVDR‑certified autoantibody test for early T1D risk detection, processed on its GSP instrument. It will be available in Europe and other CE IVD markets; not FDA‑cleared.
Regulatory-cleared product can drive adoption in EU screening programs and expand diagnostics revenue.
Near-term sales opportunity limited to CE IVD markets; U.S. excluded pending FDA clearance.
Leverages installed base in newborn screening, aiding rapid uptake and recurring reagent pull-through.
If national programs scale, could create durable, high-volume test demand.
Partnership may accelerate deployment via on-/off-site testing models.

This extends Revvity’s diagnostics strategy from newborn to broader child health screening, signaling portfolio expansion. For a larger catalyst, watch for national screening contracts, quantified adoption, and any path to FDA clearance enabling U.S. entry.
